catalyst_text: Reported negative primary endpoint with supportive secondary signals
detailed_catalyst_text: Topline results from a Phase 2/3 study in adults with focal onset seizures were announced. The trial did not meet the primary endpoint of percent change in monthly seizure frequency, but a 50% responder secondary endpoint was achieved and greater reduction was seen on the higher dose later in treatment. Safety was generally favorable with adverse event-related discontinuations under 10%.
catalyst_text_evidence: Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. (NASDAQ:PRAX), a fully integrated, leading central nervous system (CNS) precision neuroscience biopharmaceutical company, today announced results from the Phase 2/3 POWER1 study evaluating vormatrigine in patients with focal onset seizures (FOS). POWER1 Study in highly refractory patients with focal onset seizures did not meet its primary success measure Secondary measure, the 50% response rate, was met and seizure reduction during the second half of the study on higher dose (30 mg) was more pronounced Vormatrigine was generally well-tolerated; adverse event-related discontinuations were less than 10%

catalyst_text: NDA accepted PDUFA date set January 29 2027
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA accepted the NDA for ulixacaltamide HCl for essential tremor in adults and assigned a PDUFA target action date of January 29, 2027. The agency is not planning to hold an advisory committee meeting. This acceptance advances the program toward potential approval, supported by positive Phase 3 results cited in the submission.
catalyst_text_evidence: Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. (NASDAQ:PRAX), a fully integrated, leading central nervous system (CNS) precision neuroscience biopharmaceutical company, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted for review its New Drug Application (NDA) for ulixacaltamide HCl for the treatment of essential tremor (ET) in adults. The FDA has set a target action date under the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) of 2027-01-29 and is not planning to hold an advisory committee meeting.

catalyst_text: Received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for essential tremor
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation to ulixacaltamide for essential tremor, supported by positive results from the Phase 3 Essential3 program. This designation can expedite development and review for a condition with few effective treatments, highlighting the potential impact of the therapy.
catalyst_text_evidence: Essential3 is the first positive Phase 3 program in essential tremor; ulixacaltamide has received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation, with data selected for plenary presentation at AAN 2026. Ulixacaltamide, a differentiated and highly selective small molecule inhibitor of T-type calcium channels, has received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation based on results from the Essential3 study, the first positive Phase 3 program in essential tremor.

drug_indication: SCN2A Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy (early-seizure onset)
catalyst_text: Announced positive topline results from randomized pediatric trial
detailed_catalyst_text: Positive topline data were reported from the randomized, placebo-controlled EMBRAVE Part A Phase 1/2 trial in children with early-seizure onset SCN2A-DEE. Treatment produced a 77% placebo-adjusted seizure reduction and additional functional improvements, with no drug-related serious adverse events. These results support continued development and suggest potential disease-modifying benefit in this population.
catalyst_text_evidence: BOSTON, 2026-04-06 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. (NASDAQ:PRAX)... today announced positive topline results from the EMBRAVE Part A trial of elsunersen in pediatric patients with early-seizure onset SCN2A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE). EMBRAVE Part A is a randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 1/2 trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of ascending doses of elsunersen in patients with SCN2A DEE. Elsunersen treatment led to a 77% placebo-adjusted seizure reduction from baseline (p=0.015, 95 CI [33,92]... 100% of elsunersen patients improved across sleep, motor function, muscle tone, attention or neuropsychomotor development compared to no improvements in placebo group. Elsunersen was well-tolerated, with no drug-related SAEs, no discontinuations and no neuroinflammation signals at doses up to 8 mg.

catalyst_text: Received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for essential tremor
detailed_catalyst_text: FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation for ulixacaltamide to treat essential tremor, supported by positive topline results from two pivotal Phase 3 studies. The company also completed a pre-NDA meeting with the agency, aligning on NDA content. These milestones de-risk the path toward a potential filing.
catalyst_text_evidence: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) for ulixacaltamide, a differentiated and highly selective small molecule inhibitor of T-type calcium channels, for the treatment of patients with essential tremor (ET). The BTD for ulixacaltamide was based on the positive topline data from the Essential3 program, consisting of two pivotal Phase 3 studies of ulixacaltamide in ET. In December 2025, Praxis announced the successful completion of its pre-NDA meeting with the FDA, including the receipt of written feedback and an in-person meeting.
